title: 第9章 重生者在天玄圣地第10章 被卖了还得说谢谢
slug: 我气运之子反派系统什么鬼
content_zh:
“天生的本命法宝，和体质、鬼火一起觉醒的。”
墨羽胡扯道。
炎曦秀眉微蹙，红瞳中闪过一丝狐疑。
“你不会是幽冥鬼帝的亲儿子吧？”
“还有……谁家会把觉醒条件设置成双修啊？“
她也知道墨羽身世不明。
她一直以为他只是一个凡人家庭的孤儿而已。
现在看来，他爹不会真是仙帝吧？
墨羽神色平静。
“不知道，我有记忆起就没了父母。”
炎曦心中一软，红瞳中流露出一丝怜惜，柔声安慰。
“没事，你还有我呢。”
墨羽心头涌起暖流。
“谢谢啦，我的好姐姐，我的好师父。”
随后，他不再多想，转而将注意力集中在秦守的记忆上。
一旁，楚玉璃心跳微微加速。
那黑幡……
师尊不会是邪修吧？
她偷偷打量起墨羽。
气息很平和，并没有那种阴冷邪恶的感觉。

这让她悬着的心放下。
要是上了邪修的贼船可就糟了。
邪修，人人得而诛之。
这魂幡肯定是从其他邪修手上抢的！
没错，一定是这样！
墨羽很快查完了记忆。
秦家的位置，秦家周边秘境开启的时间和位置，都知道了。
关于楚玉璃的信息却少得可怜。
秦守甚至连楚玉璃就是离绯玉都不知道。
不过，还是找到了一个重要信息。
一年后，离魔尊，也就是楚玉璃，会在天玄域的一个秘境崭露头角。
墨羽决定。
到时候带楚玉璃过去，让她上交一部分资源，这样肯定也算打压。
随后，他询问系统。
“能找到那个重生者的位置吗？”
他想把那个也拐过来，慢慢打压。
【售价500反派点】
content_en:
"A natural magic weapon that awakens together with the constitution and will-o'-the-wisp."
Mo Yu said nonsense.
Yan Xi frowned slightly, and a trace of suspicion flashed in her red eyes.
"You are not the biological son of the Netherworld Ghost Emperor, are you?"
"Also...who would set the conditions for awakening to dual cultivation?"
She also knew that Mo Yu's life experience was unknown.
She always thought he was just an orphan from a mortal family.
Now it seems that his father is not really the Immortal Emperor, right?
Mo Yu looked calm.
"I don't know. My parents have been gone since I can remember."
Yan Xi's heart softened, a trace of pity showed in her red eyes, and she comforted him softly.
"It's okay, you still have me."
Warmth surged in Mo Yu's heart.
"Thank you, my good sister, my good master."
Afterwards, he stopped thinking about it and focused on Qin Shou's memory.
Beside, Chu Yuli's heartbeat accelerated slightly.
That black flag...
Master is not an evil cultivator, right?
She secretly looked at Mo Yu.
The breath is very peaceful, without that cold and evil feeling.
This put her mind at ease.
It would be terrible if he got on the evil cultivator's pirate ship.
If you practice evil, everyone will find it and punish it.
This soul flag must have been snatched from other evil cultivators!
Yes, that must be the case!
Mo Yu quickly checked his memory.
The location of the Qin family, as well as the time and location of the opening of the secret realm around the Qin family, are all known.
There is very little information about Chu Yuli.
Qin Shou didn't even know that Chu Yuli was Li Feiyu.
However, an important piece of information was found.
A year later, Lord Li Mo, also known as Chu Yuli, will emerge in a secret realm in the Tianxuan Domain.
Mo Yu decided.
When the time comes, take Chu Yuli there and ask her to hand over some resources. This will definitely be considered suppression.
Then he asked the system.
"Can you find the location of the reborn person?"
He wanted to turn that one around and slowly suppress it.
[Price: 500 villain points]
